answer: Not real-person research: 'Casey' reactions are synthetic annotations; the screenshots and observations are the behavioral evidence. Worked: keyboard focus was visible on 'Find your space', on the Gather logo after page changes, on the meeting-name input (later shown as 'Quarterly planning' on review), and on 'Edit meeting name'. Barrier: on review, 'Confirm reservation' is visible but never shown focused; after tabbing past 'Edit meeting name', a sampled frame shows the same page with no visible focus outline anywhere. This is consistent with lost or invisible focus, but evidence is insufficient to prove the code cause or an Enter outcome. Implementation and retest must establish that Confirm is in Tab order after Edit, shows a visible outline, activates with Enter/Space, and a fresh keyboard-only run reaches a confirmation screen.
